messages:
ana: dropping a quick variant for the heatmap sampling affordance. two approaches: compact legend chip vs inline p95 row control. prototype: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx/heatmap-sampling-variants
dorian: compact chip is tidy but might be invisible on first glance. inline control next to p95 is discoverable but adds clutter.
mike: can we combine? chip by default, reveal inline controls on chart focus or when user hovers the p95 label. preserves density and discoverability.
clara: love that. accessibility note: make sure reveal works with keyboard focus (not only hover). Use aria-expanded on the chip and expose the inline controls in DOM when expanded.
a11y-bot: checklist: focusable trigger, role=\"button\" with aria-pressed if toggle, tooltip content reachable by keyboard, contrast 4.5:1 for chip text on all heatmap colors.
nana: microcopy options for chip: 'Share latency', 'Live samples', 'Sampling: 1 in 200'. prefer concise. which should be default?
dorian: show rate when sampling is active: 'Live: 1 in 200'. if inactive, show icon + 'Share' to avoid scary language. tooltip can clarify: 'Sends anonymized latency samples (no request bodies)'.
mike: product question: is sampling a per-project toggle or global? affects copy: 'for this project' vs 'for your org'. product to confirm.
clara: UX: when inline controls are revealed show a small readout: 'Sampling on — est. ~5k/mo'. include a link to adjust rate in a modal instead of embedding a slider in the popover. sliders in popovers are hard for keyboard users.
a11y-bot: modal accessibility: aria-modal=true, trap focus, close with Esc, restore focus on close, label slider with aria-describedby pointing to estimate text.
dorian: responsive: at widths <420px collapse chip to icon-only and expose label in tooltip/expanded area. confirm tooltip works on touch (tap to open).
mike: animation: fade+scale for reveal, respect prefers-reduced-motion. avoid layout shifts by reserving minimal space for chip.
nana: final copy draft: collapsed chip (icon) tooltip: 'Share anonymized latency samples (no PII or request bodies). Sampling: 1 in 200. Adjust settings.' expanded chip label: 'Live: 1 in 200'. aria-label for button: 'Toggle live latency sampling'.
clara: add a11y note for screen readers: announce changes in sampling rate via aria-live polite so users hear 'Sampling rate changed to 1 in 200'.
a11y-bot: added accessibility tasks to thread: contrast check, keyboard nav tests, screen reader walkthrough, reduced-motion test.
